To reach Accomplished, ensure orbital parameters are accurate: an SSO at 600 km altitude requires a retrograde inclination (~97.8°, not 87.79°) and a 6971 km semi-major axis. Additionally, correct Kourou's latitude (~5.2°N) and match your access duration text to STK output data.","C3":"Your Conclusion successfully restates key mission parameters and sensor objectives. For Accomplished, move beyond restating design parameters by synthesising how well your design satisfies operational requirements, evaluating mission trade-offs, and drawing deeper conclusions directly from your STK simulation results.","C4":"You structured the report well and included an executive summary. To achieve Accomplished, replace informal sources like Wikipedia with peer-reviewed literature, number and label every figure, complete broken sentences (such as in Mission Duration & EOL), and ensure uniform citation formatting across your bibliography."}}
